item.title: Young adults driving renewed interest in Christianity, research finds
item.description: A new set of supplemental reports from the Evangelical Alliance suggests that young adults are emerging as a significant group among those coming to Christian faith in the UK, with authenticity, Scripture and community proving decisive factors in their journeys.

item.title: Middle East Christians warn rapid growth in faith is outpacing discipleship support
item.description: Christian leaders working across the Middle East say a surge in spiritual openness is leading thousands to explore faith in Jesus, but warn that a lack of local discipleship structures risks leaving many new believers unsupported.

item.title: Christian lecturer sacked over comments on homosexuality continues appeal
item.description: A Christian lecturer was in court this week to appeal a tribunal decision that upheld his dismissal from a Bible college for a social media post expressing traditional evangelical views on sexuality.

item.title: Cultivating the fruits of the Spirit: self-control that leads to true freedom
